Definition: from G5064 and G2532 and G1182; fourteenth:--fourteenth.
BiblicalUsage: The word tessareskaidékatos carries the sense of fourteenth. In Acts 27:27, the fourteenth night was come, and it appears again in Acts 27:33.
TheologicalSignificance: Fourteen nights adrift at sea before daylight tells me God can keep people alive long past the point where hope runs out.
